items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: The interviewee discusses Billy Moreira (Jimmy Moreira) extensively as her father's manager/mentor. ctx.x: Octave Boye. Well, he played for a couple of years, you know. He didn't keep it up. But most of the way he went to play, your daddy would recommend him to go... You know, when people would ask. Well, the most of the way he went through his life playing music, and everybody addressed him always as the past. You know, your daddy would send him, they knew he was the brother, and he'd never take it and explain him. Just Uncle Rudolph would after. Good many years, well, he'd put out his name, Boye, you see.
